title: Classic Deviled Eggs
subtitle: creamy, tangy filling piped into tender egg whites, with a sprinkle of paprika
imageAlt: A platter of classic deviled eggs with piped yellow filling and a dusting of paprika on a cream plate beside a navy napkin

beforeYouStart.text: Eggs a week or so old peel much more easily than very fresh ones.
Have a bowl of ice water ready for the cooked eggs.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Put the eggs in a pot, cover with cold water by 2 cm and bring to a boil. Turn off the heat, cover and let stand 12 minutes.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Move the eggs to ice water for 10 minutes, then peel.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Halve the eggs lengthwise and pop the yolks into a bowl. Mash the yolks fine with a fork, then stir in the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spoon or pipe the filling into the whites and dust with paprika. Chill until serving.

fixIt.fix: Overcooked; stick to 12 minutes and chill them fast.
Crack all over and peel under running water, starting at the wide end.
Push the yolks through a sieve before mixing.

saleTip: Eggs are often a loss leader at No Frills before Easter; buy two dozen.
swap: Greek yogurt for half the mayonnaise. Pickle juice for the vinegar.
leftovers: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days.
doneness: Cook eggs until the yolk and white are firm (Health Canada). Keep deviled eggs cold and out of the fridge no more than 2 hours.
source: Based on tested deviled egg methods (Canadian Living, Serious Eats): eggs brought to a boil then rested 12 minutes off the heat, iced, and filled with a mayonnaise and vinegar yolk mix.
prepAhead: Cook and peel the eggs a day ahead; make the filling and fill up to 4 hours before serving.

basic.note: Yolk, mayo, salt and pepper; no vinegar, sugar or paprika.

stepNotes.2: Basic: just mayo, salt and pepper.

fancy.note: Topped with crisp bacon bits and smoked paprika.

stepNotes.3: Fancy: dust with smoked paprika and top each with bacon.

addSteps.title: Bacon
addSteps.text: Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium 6–8 minutes until crisp, drain and crumble fine.

plating: Line them up on a platter.
Keep the platter over ice outside.

why.0-2: A splash of vinegar gives the classic tang.
why.0-3: A pinch of sugar rounds out the vinegar.

funFact: 'Deviled' has meant spicy or zesty food since the 1700s, even when, like ours, it isn't spicy at all.
